event_data.context: Started projection replay from the landed durable-storage adapters. The in-memory reader and its checkpoint API pass filtered append-order paging tests. Backend leadership, polling, filesystem ingestion, and PostgreSQL delivery and transactional projections remain open.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the projections capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Projections
